{{Otheruses|Bantha}}
The '''Bantha Bottle''' was a popular piece of merchandise sold at [[Bantha Traxx]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It was a small canteen with a hands-free neck strap, emblazoned with the a stylized [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] paw print. Sold at [[Cooling Station]]s, the canteen contained [[vitawater]] and purchasers were allowed free refills as it was aimed at patrons who attended Bantha Traxx to dance. The Bantha Bottle sold for 10 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
